body: TASK C29 is assigned: research/TASK_C29.md. Sonnet / medium / Fast off, one session. The fix lives in WorldPopulation._vacate_on_the_scale which is Claude's R42 region; do not touch it. I am in the settlement/projection region of GameState.gd for R44 at the same time - stay in the read-API region. Your C28 (aa36e27) is pushed to origin/master.
